name: Technical Articles
short: In-depth engineering articles and design methods, each linked to the calculator that does the arithmetic.

name: Formula Library
short: Every working formula in one searchable place, with variables, units and where it applies.
description: A searchable reference of the formulas behind the Elecmetric calculators and articles. Each entry states the equation, defines every variable with its unit, notes the assumptions and limits, and links to the calculator that applies it.
will: Formulas grouped by division, searchable by name, symbol or quantity
Variable table with SI unit and typical range for every symbol
Assumptions, limits of validity and common mistakes for each formula
A link to the calculator and the technical article that use it
related: Formula articles in the Conversion Centre

name: Diagram Library
short: Clear single-line, circuit, phasor and schematic diagrams you can read, copy and cite.
description: A library of engineering diagrams drawn in one consistent style: single-line diagrams, circuit and phasor diagrams, control schematics and equipment layouts. Each diagram has a plain-language caption, a legend and a link to the topic it explains.
will: Single-line, circuit, phasor, control and layout diagrams in one visual style
Every diagram readable in light and dark themes and on a phone
Legend, symbol key and a plain-language caption for each diagram
Download as SVG or PNG with credit to Elecmetric

name: Case Studies
short: Real design and fault problems worked end to end, with the numbers, the decision and the lesson.
description: Worked engineering cases from design, commissioning and fault investigation. Each case states the problem, the data, the calculation route, the decision made and what to check next time.
will: Design, commissioning and fault-finding cases with real-world numbers
The full calculation route with links to the calculators used
The decision, the alternatives rejected and why
A short lessons-learned checklist

name: MCQ Centre
short: Practice questions with worked answers, by topic and difficulty, for students and exam candidates.
description: Multiple-choice practice by division and difficulty. Every question has a worked answer, the formula used and a link to the matching calculator or article, so a wrong answer turns into a lesson.
will: Questions grouped by division, topic and difficulty
Instant marking with a worked explanation for every option
Timed sets and topic quizzes for exam practice
Progress kept on your own device only
fields: Four options and the correct answer

name: Worked Examples
short: Short, numbered calculations you can follow line by line and check against the calculators.
description: Compact worked problems with every step shown: given values, formula, substitution and result. Each one can be opened in the matching calculator to try your own numbers.
will: One problem per page with each step numbered
Given values, formula, substitution and checked result
Open the same problem in the calculator with your own numbers
Graded from basic to advanced
related: Worked-example pages in the Conversion Centre

name: Glossary
short: Plain-language definitions of electrical terms, symbols and abbreviations, with the standard they come from.
description: Definitions of electrical engineering terms, symbols and abbreviations in plain language. Each term gives the unit or symbol, a short example and links to the formula, article or calculator where it is used.
will: Terms, symbols and abbreviations searchable from A to Z
A one-line definition and a short example for each term
Unit and symbol for every quantity
Links to the related formula, article and calculator
